traffic_scope: separate regular-file one-worker QD1 zero-delay accounting; accepted requested bytes, not physical/completed bytes; timings excluded
interpretation: Production timing uses OBD_BUILD_TESTS=OFF; traffic accounting uses separate test-enabled binaries and its timing/CPU values are excluded.
All phases verify the complete byte model outside timing. The read phase is verification-warmed.
Same-process unflushed close/reopen includes synchronized extent recovery, not fresh-process startup. Final FLUSH follows this recovery.
Accepted requested bytes include retries; they are not physical device traffic or filesystem metadata.
Subsequent code changes are limited to documentation and API comments; measured runtime implementation is the recorded candidate revision.
